extensionDescription.message: Uses Firefox's built-in Reader Mode: opens automatically on supported article pages and can be toggled with a shortcut.

popupToggleLabel.message: Open Reader Mode automatically on this site

popupNoteOn.message: Readable pages will open in Reader Mode automatically.

popupNoteWhitelisted.message: This domain is on the whitelist and won't auto-open.

popupNoteCovered.message: Covered by $DOMAIN$, so it won't auto-open. Change this in Settings.

popupHostUnsupported.message: Whitelisting is not available on this page

popupUnsupportedHint.message: The whitelist only works for http and https sites.

optionsHint.message: Domains on the whitelist won't open in Reader Mode automatically; the shortcut still works. Adding example.com also covers its subdomains (e.g. www.example.com, news.example.com). Adding www.example.com covers only that host and its subdomains.

domainAriaLabel.message: Domain to add to the whitelist

optionsEmpty.message: The whitelist is empty. Reader Mode will open automatically on all supported pages.

errorInvalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain, such as example.com
